answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 50991 Country: India Title: halal Question: My father is tobacco merchant. I want to know that is it lawful to trade tobacco and earn money to run my house? Answer ID: 50991 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 318/318/M=04/1435) The said business and its income is not haram, so it is lawful. However if you do any other pure business then it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
